title: 無表示画面のマイクロフィルム閲覧機
description: 図書館や資料閲覧室の机上に置くマイクロフィルム閲覧機。フード付き大型表示面、下の二個のフィルムリールと無地フィルム経路/中央ゲート、巻取つまみ、側面ピントつまみ、背面通気/接続部と足を造形しています。画面は不透明な無表示面で、資料画像や文字、光学投影、巻取/ピント調節機能は含みません。リールと本体は一式1点。机の高さに合わせて配置する静的な室内小物です。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。 外接寸法（X×Y×Z）0.520 × 0.793 × 0.520 m、8,876三角形。単位m・Y-up、水平中央の接地用原点、最下点Y=0。部品ごとの重複UV0と単色PBR材質を収録し、画像テクスチャ・UV2・コライダー・LOD・リグ・動作は付属しません。静的表示用でUnity/VRChat実機検証は未実施。STLはm・Y-up座標の形状のみで色・材質・UV・階層を含みません。
descriptionEn: A microfilm reader for library and archive desks. It includes a large hooded screen, two film reels with a blank film path/central gate, winding knobs, side focus dial, rear ventilation/connections and feet. The screen is opaque and blank; no archive imagery, text, optical projection, winding or focusing behavior is supplied. Reels and cabinet form one model. Adjust placement to desk height as a static interior prop. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing. Bounding dimensions (X×Y×Z): 0.520 × 0.793 × 0.520 m; 8,876 triangles. Metres, Y-up, horizontally centered placement origin with minimum Y=0, not an articulation or wall-mount pivot. Includes overlapping component UV0 and constant-color PBR materials, with no image textures, unique UV2, colliders, LOD, rig or runtime behavior. Static visualization only; Unity/VRChat editor and runtime tests have not been performed. STL uses metre-valued Y-up coordinates and contains geometry only, without color, materials, UVs or hierarchy.
author: Xenoah
uv: Per-component primitive or automatically unwrapped UVs. Overlapping between components; not a packed unique lightmap atlas. Solid-color PBR materials; no external textures. STL has no colors or UVs.
